reviews.review:
Warframe is an amazing game. Its a third person co-op sci-fi shooter space ninja extravaganza! Its a little slow starting out (if you have the money, i recommend  getting affinity and credit boosters), but once you get past the first planet or two, you really start to have some great fun. With a good team and communication, this game offers hours of never ending entertainment. Each Warframe (playable character) offers its own unique play and fighting style. With (Currently) 16 Warframes and 3 prime variants (the 4th, excalibur prime is no longer attainable), over 100 primary, secondary, and melee weapons, and 5 sentinels (robotic companions), this game has massive replayability. The very best part is, its free! So why not try it out? 

P.S. Dont stop after the first couple missions, I promise you'll find its an amazing game!

If you are having second thoughts on weather you should get this game, let me end it for you by saying that you should.

Everything about this game is extremely fun and entirely possible for any player. Yes you can spend money to get things such as weapons or warframes, but the only things you have to spend money on are completely cosmetic things such as colors and scarves.

Yes, you will have to grind to get things in this, but if you have friends to play this with, or take every combat situation as something new, it doesn't even feel like grinding, it feels like playing and like fun.

And even though the mission have limited types, the amazing devolopers are always adding new things to keep the game fresh and new.

Even if they didn't though, a mission could change completely based on what Lotus (your contact on everything going on) thinks you should do, or your own actions on other missions.

And then there are weapons you can only get if your in a clan. You can still get them even if you don't get into a huge and powerful clan.

I know this because I am in a clan with one other active player, and have 2/3 of the weapons and warframes researched.

Trust me when I say it, you will love this game. Just look at my hours on it.

good

2026 edit:

Seeing this old review i had posted back in 2013... and coming back 13 years later to see it, so many memories, the game was rough back then, all the menus, all the bosses, the parkour, the weapons, all of it. Seeing the game 13 years later being so... polished, so smooth, brings me nothing but joy. Warframe is the goat and one of the few with the best community out there!
